Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands split along 3 parallel gently undulating curves running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 35% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 70% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 2 is the diagonal band between dividing curve 1 and dividing curve 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, dragon phoenix formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and CRIMSON, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the diagonal band between dividing curve 2 and dividing curve 3: it carries layers of real feathers overlapping like plumage, every feather with its own shaft and fine barbs ruffling at the edges and casting small shadows on the feathers below, BLAZING snow-white plumage with blush-pink tips, VIVID long sweeping quill feathers and loose down floating around her. extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
